name: Chaud-froid of Chicken
description: Historical recipe from The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: ¾ teaspoon granulated gelatine dissolved in one tablespoon hot water
ingredients.originalText: ¾ teaspoon granulated gelatine dissolved in one tablespoon hot water

ingredients.name: pieces cooked chicken, shaped in form of cutlets
ingredients.originalText: 6 pieces cooked chicken, shaped in form of cutlets

instructions.text: Make a sauce of butter, flour, and stock; add egg yolk diluted with cream, lemon juice, salt and pepper; then add dissolved gelatine.
Dip chicken in sauce which has been allowed to cool.
When chicken has cooled, garnish upper side with truffles cut in shapes.
Brush over with aspic jelly mixture, and chill.
Arrange a bed of lettuce; in centre pile cold cooked asparagus tips or celery cut in small pieces, marinated with French Dressing, and place chicken at base of salad.

source.author: Fannie Merritt Farmer
source.originalInstructions:
1. Make a sauce of butter, flour, and stock; add egg yolk diluted with cream, lemon juice, salt and pepper; then add dissolved gelatine.
2. Dip chicken in sauce which has been allowed to cool.
3. When chicken has cooled, garnish upper side with truffles cut in shapes.
4. Brush over with aspic jelly mixture, and chill.
5. Arrange a bed of lettuce; in centre pile cold cooked asparagus tips or celery cut in small pieces, marinated with French Dressing, and place chicken at base of salad.

6 pieces cooked chicken, shaped in form of cutlets
